recipes.name: Iron Mace
recipes.description: A solid iron mace forged from raw ore. Reliable blunt-force weapon capable of stunning enemies.

recipes.name: Heavy War Mace
recipes.description: A reinforced war mace incorporating salvaged orc steel and hardened hide grip. Superior impact force.

recipes.name: Spiked Morningstar
recipes.description: A brutal spiked morningstar forged from the finest orcish steel. Devastating stun potential.

recipes.name: Iron Longsword
recipes.description: A versatile one-handed iron longsword, balanced for both standalone striking and pairing with a shield or offhand blade.

recipes.name: Two-Handed Longsword
recipes.description: A heavy two-handed longsword demanding both hands on the hilt. Deals heavy impact damage at the expense of offhand flexibility.

recipes.name: Lockpick
recipes.description: A slender steel pick forged from scrap metal. Essential tool required to pick Locked Boxes.

recipes.name: Smelt Broken Lockbox
recipes.description: Smelt a ruined lockbox in the forge to reclaim 2 Steel Scrap.
